messages:
olivia (PM): FYI — dropping a short PRD draft for the Tier Affinity routing policy. Need decisions on tiers, region pinning, and compatible model fallbacks by EOD Fri. Quick read + reactions appreciated. Link: https://pm/repo/tier-affinity-prd-draft

sam (Eng-Platform): glanced, a couple quick q's: how strict is 'affinity'? can we allow cross-region fallthrough for low latency vs cost? :thinking_face:

olivia (PM): @sam Good q. Draft suggests three modes: strict (no cross-region), soft (prefer same-region, fallback allowed), and elastic (ignore region for availability). Acceptance criteria in doc but open.

yuki (Eng-ML): For model variants compatibility, we need a 2-way compatibility matrix. Example: gptx-1.0-qa-quant -> gptx-1.1-qa-nonquant. Some model diffs will break function-calling. Propose 'capability tags' instead of exact model match (e.g., `function_calling`, `structured_output`).

tara (Infra): Implementation note — soft mode requires cross-region KV cache keying. Danger: KV cache miss storm and increased egress. We should add rate-limiting and gradual rollout hooks.

jeff (Customer Success): Several enterprise customers asked for 'strict' mode with region pinning + audit logs. Need SLA language: route changes must not exceed 5% error increase and must be reversible within 15m.

olivia (PM): Acceptance criteria proposal (short): - Tier definitions (free/dev/prod) mapped to default modes - Rollout flag + canary at 1% - Metric: p95 latency <= baseline + 20ms - Quality regression: prompt set pass rate >= 98% vs baseline - Fallback success rate >= 99% (i.e., responses not 500). Thoughts?

sam (Eng-Platform): Add: fallback must preserve function-calling compatibility. If fallback would drop a capability, prefer degrade gracefully and annotate response with `x-fallback-reason`. Also require a metric `fallback.capability_loss` to be <0.5% on rollout.

yuki (Eng-ML): Agreed. Add capability tags mapping for each model variant. Compatibility check is set inclusion: request requires tags subset of model tags. I'll produce mapping and a small test harness.

olivia (PM): Snippet for routing policy config to include in PRD: ```json
{
  "policy": "tier_affinity",
  "modes": ["strict","soft","elastic"],
  "tier_defaults": {"prod":"strict","dev":"soft","free":"elastic"},
  "compatibility": {"require_tags": ["function_calling"]}
}
```

tara (Infra): Runtime concerns: we need atomic switch per-request when model unavailable. Implementation sketch: envoy filter -> arbiter service -> choose route. We'll need new metrics: `route.choice`, `fallback.reason`, `compat.check`, and histograms for cross-region egress. Also add guidance for canary rollback.

jeff (Customer Success): For customers, expose admin UI toggle and an audit log CSV export (include old route, new route, timestamp, triggered_by). Also want a compliance export for auditors.

policy-bot: RFC checklist created. Next step: open RFC PR and link to PRD. /assign @sam @yuki

olivia (PM): Ok can we lock down acceptance criteria and ship RFC by Mon? If no blockers, I'll create RFC PR tonight. @tara can you confirm infra gating items?

tara (Infra): Confirmed. I'll list infra blockers in PR description: KV namespace cross-region, envoy filter, rollout hooks, and egress cost guardrails.

sam (Eng-Platform): I'll volunteer to own the arbiter service prototype. ETA 2 weeks for MVP (prototype routing + metrics + canary flag).

yuki (Eng-ML): I'll own compatibility tag mapping for models + eval harness. Will produce small eval set focusing on function-calling and structured output regressions.

jeff (Customer Success): I'll draft customer-facing doc + suggested SLA language and a short migration guide for customers on strict mode.

olivia (PM): Great. If anyone has objections, drop them here. Otherwise I'll mark as 'ready for RFC' at 1967654987. :rocket:

alex (Legal): Quick note: check data residency constraints for strict region pinning — some customers require full isolation (no cross-region egress at all). We should flag legal/regulatory review in PRD.
